rows.commentary: 0.1: Akeal Hosein opens the attack with a leg-lined delivery that Abhishek Sharma guides fine, only for a sharp dive to his left at short fine leg to deny the boundary.
0.2: Akeal Hosein immediately extracts vicious turn into Sanju Samson, forcing a scrambling single off the bat.
0.3: Abhishek Sharma does not score off Akeal Hosein.
0.4: Akeal Hosein loops this one through, Abhishek Sharma works it smartly into the gap, and they scamper back for a brisk couple of runs.
0.5: Akeal Hosein darts through a flat, swift delivery that Abhishek Sharma meets from middle and leg, driving firmly straight to mid-off.
0.6: Akeal Hosein is launched into the stratosphere as Abhishek Sharma unleashes a ferocious strike that sails all the way over deep extra cover for six.
1.1: Shepherd darts one into the pads at 119.9kph, and Samson angles the late clip straight to the fielder stationed at short fine leg.
1.2: Romario Shepherd drops it short on the stumps, and Sanju Samson nudges it away toward mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
1.3: Romario Shepherd drops it right on off-stump, and Abhishek Sharma simply pushes the length delivery towards cover point for a dot.

1.4: Romario Shepherd delivers into the channel at one hundred thirty-one point two kilometers per hour, and Abhishek Sharma clears his front leg to carve an exquisite boundary through extra cover with pure timing.
1.5: Romario Shepherd follows up by pitching it to Abhishek Sharma, who collects a comfortable couple of runs driven firmly out towards sweeper cover.

1.6: Romario Shepherd rolls his fingers over the ball for a sluggish off-pace delivery, but Abhishek Sharma reads the variation early, getting underneath the full length to loft it straight down the ground for a boundary that brings eleven from the over.
2.1: Hosein angles it in on a length, Samson flashes hard with a thick edge racing past the keeper to the rope.
2.2: Sanju Samson does not score off Akeal Hosein.
2.3: No-ball from Akeal Hosein to Sanju Samson.
2.3: Sanju Samson clears the boundary off Akeal Hosein for six.
2.4: Dot ball from Akeal Hosein to Sanju Samson.
2.5: Akeal Hosein loops this one through, Sanju Samson sweeps it firmly into the turf, and they scamper back for a comfortable second run to deep square leg.
2.6: Akeal Hosein delivers to Sanju Samson, worked smoothly toward mid-off for a single.
3.1: Sanju Samson meets Roston Chase with immediate authority, launching the ball over extra cover to race away for four.
3.2: Roston Chase darts a searing, pads-bound delivery at lightning speed, allowing Sanju Samson to cleanly flick it away into the deep for an easy rotation of the strike.
3.3: Roston Chase imparts sharp away turn off a length, drawing a deep-creased, mistimed slog from Abhishek Sharma out to long-off for a single.
3.4: Sanju Samson takes a single off Roston Chase.
3.5: Roston Chase darts it in flat on the middle stump, jamming Abhishek Sharma for room as he nudges it away into the off side.
3.6: Roston Chase strikes as Abhishek Sharma chases a big shot after a clutch of dots, skied straight to Gudakesh Motie to depart for twenty.
4.1: Akeal Hosein pitches it up and Sanju Samson punishes it with a crisp drive over cover for four.
4.2: Akeal Hosein loops this through the air, and Sanju Samson launches it effortlessly over the ropes for a magnificent maximum.
4.3: Akeal Hosein loops this full delivery into the arc of Sanju Samson, who stays rooted deep in his crease and launches a flat, brutal maximum straight down the ground.
4.4: Akeal Hosein drifts this fullish delivery into the pads, and Sanju Samson hoicks it off the inside half past a scrambling short fine leg on a lightning-quick outfield to race away for four.
4.5: Hosein comes from over the wicket, dropping it on a length, and Samson slaps the ball firmly out to long-off for a brisk single.
4.6: Ishan Kishan takes a single off Akeal Hosein.
Sanju Samson is putting on a show, smashing two massive sixes off the last two deliveries to send the crowd wild!
5.1: Romario Shepherd bangs it in hard and Ishan Kishan defends awkwardly with one hand slipping off the handle as the ball whistles past the woodwork.

5.2: Romario Shepherd drops it short and wide, inviting the slash that Ishan Kishan aggressively thrashes past a full-length diving Chase at point who gets a fingertip to it before the ball races away to the deep cover-point fence.
5.3: Romario Shepherd steams in again to Ishan Kishan, yielding a single that comes via a nervous, hesitant mix-up between Kishan and Samson in the middle.
5.4: Romario Shepherd drops it short to Sanju Samson, who punches it firmly toward long-off and scambers back for a sharp couple of runs.
5.5: Romario Shepherd tries to adjust his length, but Sanju Samson meets it with a blistering drive straight down the ground toward long-on for a cracking boundary.
5.6: Four to Sanju Samson off Romario Shepherd.
6.1: Gudakesh Motie delivers a full ball angling across off stump, and Ishan Kishan nudges it firmly toward the cover region for a single.
6.2: Gudakesh Motie hunts down Sanju Samson outside his leg stump with a length delivery, and Samson drives it away to long-off for an easy run.
6.3: Dot ball from Gudakesh Motie to Ishan Kishan.
6.4: Gudakesh Motie darts this fullish delivery into Ishan Kishan, who chops it dead toward mid-off without a hint of timing.
6.5: Gudakesh Motie offers up a full toss, and Ishan Kishan dispatches it with absolute authority all the way over the rope for six.
6.6: Motie fires this one through on a brisk, short length near the wide outside corridor, tempting Kishan into a wild slash that ultimately claws through to the keeper without contact.
7.1: A single to Sanju Samson off Roston Chase.
7.2: Dot ball from Roston Chase to Ishan Kishan.
7.3: Chase delivers to Kishan, who dances down the pitch only to drive straight into the hands of the cover fielder for a dot.
7.4: Kishan moves deep in his crease to pull Chase away past the infield, racing all the way to the fine leg boundary for four.
7.5: Roston Chase keeps it flat around off from round the wicket, and Ishan Kishan deftly steers it toward point to sprint through for a sharp single.
7.6: Roston Chase tosses this one very full on off, allowing Sanju Samson to punch it toward deep extra cover for a brisk single.
8.1: Gudakesh Motie drops it into the arc and Sanju Samson launches it high and handsome, clearing the long-on rope with absolute disdain.
8.2: Motie digs it in short once more, and Samson pulls it forcefully into the wide expanse toward long-on for a brisk single.
8.3: Motie drifts it across at ninety-six kph, and Kishan can only drag his heavy heave down to long-on for a single.
8.4: Motie reads Samson's premeditated shuffle and fires it full into the pads, trapping the Rajasthan skipper dead in front for a dot.
8.5: Motie offers ample width, and Samson stands tall to launch the short ball over extra cover for four.
8.6: Gudakesh Motie drops it full on the leg-side, and Sanju Samson works it away into the deep midwicket grass for a single.
9.1: Shamar Joseph charges in at 145.9kph, drifting onto the pads for Sanju Samson to expertly guide past short fine leg for a boundary.
9.2: Shamar Joseph rebounds instantly with a sharp dot ball to stifle Sanju Samson.
9.3: Joseph charges in and fires it full at 145 clicks, catching the inside half of Samson's blade as he drives it away for a single out toward deep square leg.
9.4: Shamar Joseph hurls it in short at a searing 142 clicks, but Ishan Kishan reads the low trajectory instantly to effortlessly hook it over fine leg for a maximum.
9.5: Shamar Joseph persists with the length, and Ishan Kishan swiftly pivots to dispatch this one away to the deep square leg fence for four.

9.6: Shamar Joseph drifts one straying down the leg side past Ishan Kishan, prompting an immediate wide signal from the umpire before Shai Hope forces a referral upstairs to check for a faint feather off the bat.
9.6: Ishan Kishan finds the boundary off Shamar Joseph for four.
10.1: Shamar Springer delivers to Sanju Samson, guiding the ball away toward square third man to pick up a single.
10.2: Shamar Springer bowls a 125.7kph half‑volley to Ishan Kishan, who swings the bottom hand into the gap between mid‑off and cover for a four.
10.3: Shamar Springer delivers a fuller ball to Ishan Kishan, who thumps it past the stumps to long‑on for a single.
10.4: Shamar Springer fires it in as Sanju Samson drills the low full toss down to long-on for a single.
10.5: Shamar Springer delivers to Ishan Kishan, who guides it away toward third man for four.
10.6: A single to Ishan Kishan off Shamar Springer.
11.1: Roston Chase breaches Ishan Kishan's defenses with a beauty, rattling the woodwork to send the opener packing for 43 and claiming his third T20I scalp of the left-hander.
11.2: Chase flights one that grips and bites away past the bat, leaving Dube to anchor his stance on the leg side and steer the push firmly toward cover.
11.3: Roston Chase keeps it flat, forcing Shivam Dube back to punch firmly toward the cover region for a dot.
11.4: Roston Chase drifts completely down the leg-side for a wide as he frantically denies Shivam Dube any hint of air or length.
11.4: Roston Chase suddenly alters his pacing, delivering a slower, fuller ball that catches Shivam Dube completely off guard.
11.5: Roston Chase floats it up, and Shivam Dube springs onto the back foot to punch it aerially for a single.
11.6: Roston Chase floats it full into the stumps, and Sanju Samson drills it down to long-on to squeeze out a single, wrapping up a quiet three-run over.
12.1: Romario Shepherd strays well past the tramlines on the off side, and Sanju Samson simply watches it pass by without offering a stroke.
12.1: Romario Shepherd drops a low full toss sliding down the leg-side, and Sanju Samson reaches fruitlessly in his attempt to glance it to the rope.
12.1: Romario Shepherd completely loses his radar here against Sanju Samson, spraying a wide so far off-target that the umpires must verify if it even landed on the cut strip.
12.1: Romario Shepherd serves one up to Sanju Samson, and it races away to the third man boundary.
12.2: Sanju Samson takes a single off Romario Shepherd.
12.3: Romario Shepherd delivers a full length to Shivam Dube, who nudges it cleanly into the mid-wicket region for a sharp single.
12.4: Romario Shepherd strays wide outside off to Sanju Samson, offering no refuge in the slippery dew.
12.4: Romario Shepherd targets the toes with a low full toss that Sanju Samson clips cleanly over mid-wicket for a single.
12.5: Romario Shepherd ties Shivam Dube up completely with a sharp delivery, denying any room for the slog.
12.6: Shepherd digs it in short on the leg-side, and Dube whips it away smoothly to collect a single in the deep.
13.1: Roston Chase floats it up in the slot, and Shivam Dube launches a slog that beats the despairing dive at deep mid-wicket, racing away to the boundary.
13.2: Roston Chase fires in a pinpoint yorker outside off, squeezing Shivam Dube into a desperate block towards point for a dot.
13.3: Roston Chase outsmarts Shivam Dube with a clever change of pace, dragging the ball back onto the stumps as Dube swings wildly and departs for 7.
13.4: Roston Chase floats it up, and Shreyas Iyer drives it down to long-on for a single.
13.5: Roston Chase floats it full and straight, and Sanju Samson clips it firmly out to deep mid-wicket for a comfortable single.
13.6: Roston Chase pushes the final delivery full and wide of off stump, allowing Shreyas Iyer to drill it straight down to long-off for one.
14.1: Springer serves it full, and Shreyas Iyer tickles it off the inner half down to long-on for a brisk single.
14.2: Shamar Springer targets the base of the stumps with a searing yorker, jamming Sanju Samson who hastily withdraws his front boot just in time to jam it into the pitch.
14.3: Shamar Springer digs into another short offering that Sanju Samson skies high into the night, picking out Kamil Pooran at square third man to end a brilliant 82-run knock.
14.4: Shamar Springer pitches it up, and Tilak Varma drills the drive firmly toward mid-off to collect four runs.
14.5: Shamar Springer delivers to Tilak Varma, who works it away into the deep mid-wicket region and scampers back industrially for a well-run couple.
14.6: Springer spears a low full toss wide of off, and Varma carves it firmly to deep point for a single.

15.1: Shamar Joseph rolls his fingers across the seam with a clever pace-off delivery, catching Tilak Varma expecting a heave, forcing him to adjust instantly and punch it firmly off the back foot along the turf through cover-point for a single.
15.2: Shamar Joseph hurls it down, and Shreyas Iyer lofts the delivery cleanly over mid-off to find the rope.
15.3: Shamar Joseph digs it in short outside off, and Shreyas Iyer hurriedly flat-bats the delivery down to the deep fielder stationed at long-off for a single.
15.4: A single to Tilak Varma off Shamar Joseph.
15.5: Shamar Joseph unleashes a searing 146kph yorker on the off stump, which Shreyas Iyer hurriedly squeezes down toward short third man for a single.
15.6: Shamar Joseph rolls his fingers over this slower delivery outside off, inducing a bottom-edged miscue as Tilak Varma reaches out to drive it toward mid-off.
16.1: Shepherd fires a wide yorker outside off, and Varma digs it out firmly toward cover for a single.
16.2: Romario Shepherd delivers, and Shreyas Iyer effortlessly deposits it over the ropes, carrying his sublime Lucknow form right into Ranchi with pure, unadulterated timing.
16.3: Shepherd targets the off stump with a full length, forcing Iyer to drag the delivery away toward deep midwicket for a single.
16.4: Romario Shepherd digs it in short on the off stump, and Tilak Varma mistimes the pull away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
16.5: Rovman Powell drops it in, Shreyas Iyer launches it skyward, and gravity yields as the ball clears the rope with room to spare.
16.6: Rovman Powell fires it across, and Shreyas Iyer guides the low full toss sharply toward deep cover to collect a single.
17.1: Shamar Springer delivers on a length to off stump, and Shreyas Iyer steps across to nonchalantly flick the ball over deep midwicket for a maximum.
17.2: Shamar Springer digs out an off-side yorker, allowing Shreyas Iyer to squeeze a single down toward third man.
17.3: Shamar Springer delivers a wide low full toss that Tilak Varma reaches across to dispatch emphatically to the boundary.
17.4: Shamar Springer digs it into the surface outside off, allowing Tilak Varma to establish a firm back-foot base and reach out to slice it over point for four.
17.5: Shamar Springer oversteps with a no-ball, conceding a single as Tilak Varma works it out to sweeper cover.
17.5: Shamar Springer digs it in short outside off on the free-hit, Shreyas Iyer throws the kitchen sink at it and makes zero contact before casting an ambitious appeal toward the umpire.
17.6: Shamar Springer drifts too full, and Shreyas Iyer punishes the delivery to the boundary, swelling the crucial stand alongside Tilak Varma.
18.1: Shamar Joseph digs it in short, rushing Tilak Varma on the pull into a mistimed stroke that safely finds the empty expanses of mid-wicket for a brace.
18.2: Shamar Joseph loops up a darting full ball, and Tilak Varma drills the drive straight down to mid-off to pinch a single.
18.3: Shamar Joseph sprays a 143.7kph bouncer with wide width, allowing Shreyas Iyer to gleefully ramp it over the infield for a one-bounce boundary.
18.4: A leg bye off Shamar Joseph's delivery to Shreyas Iyer.
18.5: Shamar Joseph reads the shuffle, rolling out a clever slower ball that catches Tilak Varma's inside edge off the pad, allowing Shreyas and Tilak to sprint through for a sharp single.

18.6: Shamar Joseph digs out a low full toss that Shreyas Iyer sweeps away into the deep mid-wicket pocket, where Keemo performs a brilliant sliding interception just inches before the boundary cushions.
19.1: Tilak Varma clears the boundary off Shamar Springer for six.
19.2: Shamar Springer misses his wide length with a low full toss, allowing Tilak Varma to launch it over long-off toward the sightscreen.
19.3: Springer fires it back of a length outside off, and Varma drops deep in his crease to pull it flat and fierce over cow corner for six.
19.4: Shamar Springer lands a low full toss that Tilak Varma whips out to long-on, immediately shaking his head in sheer frustration at missing out on the boundary.
19.5: Shamar Springer digs it in short, catches Shreyas Iyer high on the splice, and Shimron Hetmyer settles safely beneath the skier at deep mid-wicket to snap up the 40-run cameo.

19.6: Shamar Springer bangs it down as Naman Dhir guides it away, leaving Hetmyer sprinting hard to his right at deep mid-wicket where his desperate low dive just misses the ball as it races to the rope for four.
Tilak Varma connects with absolute power, dispatching the last two deliveries over the ropes to light up the innings!

0.1: Mayank Yadav hurls down a blistering 144kph delivery that shapes away, forcing Shai Hope to flat-bat a fierce return straight back that the bowler desperately claws at with his right hand without securing it.
0.2: Mayank Yadav is greeted by Kamil Pooran with a powerful strike that races away to the long-off boundary.
0.3: Mayank Yadav strikes as Kamil Pooran falls for 4, safely caught by substitute Ravi Bishnoi.
0.4: Mayank Yadav unleashes lightning, searing it straight through Shimron Hetmyer's defenses to scatter the timber and strike a golden blow.
0.5: Mayank Yadav serves up a low full toss that Rovman Powell whips away toward deep mid-wicket, eluding Bishnoi's desperate forward dive as it races to the rope for four.
0.6: Mayank Yadav unleashes a searing 144kph thunderbolt that flashes straight past Rovman Powell's flailing bat, leaving the batsman completely beaten.
1.1: Arshdeep Singh offers width outside off and Shai Hope violently dismisses the length delivery through the cover region, picking up four authoritative runs.
1.2: Arshdeep Singh overcompensates with a full delivery planted straight into the pads, allowing Shai Hope to whip it decisively over mid-wicket for consecutive boundaries.
1.3: Arshdeep Singh responds instantly with a sharp bouncer that hurries past Shai Hope, yielding no run.
1.4: Arshdeep Singh drops it short and angles it away, allowing Shai Hope to rise on his toes and drive it toward sweeper cover for a single.
1.5: Dot ball from Arshdeep Singh to Rovman Powell.
1.6: Arshdeep Singh delivers a sharp snorter that brushes the glove of Rovman Powell, prompting a long, cold stare from the bowler.
2.1: Mayank Yadav unleashes raw pace at nearly 145kph, extracting sharp lift from the surface to zip past Shai Hope without offering a run.
2.2: Mayank Yadav unleashes raw gas, extracting vicious lift outside off as Shai Hope clears his front leg in vain.
2.3: Mayank Yadav drops it short on off, Shai Hope backs away to launch it over mid-on, and Arshdeep saves the boundary with a remarkable effort near the ropes to keep it to three.
2.4: Mayank Yadav digs another fierce bouncer in at Rovman Powell, who ducks underneath it decisively as the delivery sails harmlessly through to the keeper.
2.5: Mayank Yadav unleashes raw pace into Rovman Powell, who swivels deep in his crease to hook the ball over the backward square leg boundary for six.
2.6: Mayank Yadav steams in, and Rovman Powell unleashes a ferocious swipe behind square, relying on the sheer velocity of the delivery to race away to the boundary.
3.1: Axar Patel floats it up with subtle drift, and Shai Hope clears room to loft it inside out over extra cover for a crisp boundary.
3.2: Axar Patel pulls his length back, but Shai Hope reads the adjustment instantly, annihilating the short ball high over mid-on and sending it soaring over the rope for six.
3.3: Axar Patel rolls his fingers across this delivery, and Shai Hope can only slap the angling length ball straight to point for a dot.
3.4: Axar drops it short and Shai Hope rocks back, dispatching the delivery over long-on for a towering maximum.
3.5: Axar darts this one in, catching Shai Hope plumb on the back leg as the batter misses his intended whip across the line.
3.6: Axar Patel unleashes a searing 104.6kph yorker near the off stump, catching Shai Hope's inside edge as the batsman jams it painfully into his own pads.
4.1: Arshdeep Singh drops a low full toss near off stump, drilled smoothly by Rovman Powell toward mid-off where Iyer launches into a sharp diving stop to restrict the stroke to a single.
4.2: Arshdeep Singh charges in to deliver to Shai Hope, who pushes the ball firmly into the extra cover region to scamper across for a quick run.
4.3: No run for Rovman Powell off Arshdeep Singh.

4.4: Arshdeep Singh drifts it up full on off, and Rovman Powell anchors deep in his crease, presenting the full face of a beautifully timed stroke that lobs over mid-off and races away to the deep extra cover boundary.
4.5: Arshdeep Singh drops it short outside off, and Rovman Powell's mistimed pull off the top half finds the vacant turf to scamper away for four.
4.6: Arshdeep Singh fires in a low full toss targeting the pads, and Rovman Powell instantly pushes it toward mid-on to scamper through for a sharp single.
5.1: Mayank Yadav unleashes a blistering 149.5kph thunderbolt that shatters Rovman Powell's off stump and ends his stay on 24.
5.2: Mayank Yadav unleashes a blistering 145.3kph thunderbolt angling across a length, prompting Sherfane Rutherford to gently pat it toward backward point.
5.3: Mayank Yadav drops it short outside off, and Sherfane Rutherford swats a venomous pull through the gap between mid-on and mid-wicket, racing away to four and opening his account in style.
5.4: Sherfane Rutherford finds the boundary off Mayank Yadav for four.
5.5: Mayank Yadav drops it right in the slot on the stumps, and Sherfane Rutherford clears the deep square leg boundary with a ferocious cross-line swipe for six.
5.6: Mayank Yadav hurls down a hostile delivery that jams Sherfane Rutherford for room, forcing a desperate defensive push back to the bowler for no score.
6.1: Shivam Dube delivers to Shai Hope, who plays a delicate, Test-match style dab that trickles all the way down to the deep backward point boundary.
6.2: Shivam Dube delivers a fuller ball swinging inward, and Shai Hope strokes it away into the turf toward long-on for a single.
6.3: Shivam Dube angles it short across Sherfane Rutherford, who effortlessly opens the bat face and glides it past point to the rope.
6.4: Shivam Dube delivers a low full toss from middle and leg, safely worked by Sherfane Rutherford toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
6.5: Shivam Dube bowls a wide to Shai Hope.
6.5: Shivam Dube bangs it hard into the pads, leaving Shai Hope to drop his wrists and glide a gentle flick toward deep mid-wicket for a comfortable couple.
6.6: Shivam Dube slides it in, and Shai Hope strokes it cleanly to sweeper cover for a single.
7.1: Kuldeep Yadav drops it slightly too full near the off stump, allowing Shai Hope to carve a single out to sweeper cover.
7.2: Kuldeep Yadav absorbs maximum punishment as Sherfane Rutherford launches him towering over deep mid-wicket for a magnificent six.
7.3: Kuldeep Yadav serves it up full on middle and leg, and Sherfane Rutherford drives it away into the deep mid-wicket region to hustle back for a brisk couple.
7.4: Kuldeep Yadav floats this legbreak outside off, and Sherfane Rutherford drills it straight back down the ground before Axar cuts it off sweeping across from long-on.
7.5: Kuldeep Yadav drifts through the air, and Shai Hope rocks back to steer it gently toward sweeper cover for a single.
7.6: Kuldeep Yadav darts a flat delivery across the width, and Sherfane Rutherford slices his cut straight to point.
8.1: Shivam Dube delivers into the slot, and Shai Hope clears the front leg with absolute authority, launching the ball majestically over long-on for a maximum.
8.2: Shivam Dube pulls back his length just a fraction, allowing Shai Hope to push the ball down toward long-on and jog through comfortably for a single.
8.3: Shivam Dube delivers a searing low full toss straight into the stumps, and Sherfane Rutherford digs it out firmly down the ground to scamper back for two brisk runs.
8.4: Shivam Dube spears it full at Sherfane Rutherford, who looks to clear the ropes but only manages an inside edge thudding into his pads.
8.5: Shivam Dube fires another one in to Sherfane Rutherford, who strokes this delivery out towards sweeper cover for a single.
8.6: Shivam Dube drops it short around off stump, and Shai Hope violently pulls it flat over deep mid-wicket for a maximum to bring up his half-century off just 24 balls.
9.1: Kuldeep Yadav serves one up, and Sherfane Rutherford launches it straight down the ground over long-on for a massive six.
9.2: Kuldeep Yadav fires it in full onto the pads, and Sherfane Rutherford flicks it away to short fine leg where Mayank swoops with a sharp dive to his right to save the boundary.
9.3: Kuldeep tosses it wide outside off, and Hope slices the aerial drive out to the sweeper cover fielder on the bounce.
9.4: Kuldeep gets one past Rutherford as the batter misses the cut completely.
9.5: Kuldeep floats it slightly shorter on off stump, drawing a sharp defensive stroke from Sherfane Rutherford straight to Abhishek stationed at point.
9.6: Kuldeep Yadav hurls his frustration into the turf as Mayank Yadav spills a straightforward catch from Sherfane Rutherford at short fine leg.
10.1: Naman Dhir delivers to Sherfane Rutherford, who clears the front leg against the flight and launches it high over deep midwicket for a maximum.
10.2: Dhir hunts for the tramlines with a wide yorker, forcing Sherfane Rutherford to reach out and squeeze the ball desperately toward the off-side.
10.3: Dhir keeps pushing it wide on the off-side, leaving Sherfane Rutherford to reach across and try to slice a flatter trajectory through the field.

10.4: Naman Dhir flattens one in around the off-stump, coaxing a gentle tap to cover from Sherfane Rutherford as Hope instigates a dash for a razor-thin single, answered by a bullet throw from the outfield.
10.5: Naman Dhir drops it flat just outside off, and Shai Hope brings a dead straight bat down to push it safely back to the turf.
10.6: Naman Dhir imparts sharp turn and unexpected bounce into the pads as Hope misses the glance, deflecting it off the thigh pad toward short fine leg.
11.1: Axar Patel offers a full delivery right in the arc, allowing Sherfane Rutherford to flex his muscles and launch it powerfully over long-off for a maximum.
11.2: Axar Patel darts it in at ninety-seven kilometers per hour, skidding low past Sherfane Rutherford's fierce cross-line heave.
11.3: Axar Patel stretches the line beyond the tramlines once more, drawing an immediate wide signal from the umpire.
11.3: Sherfane Rutherford unleashes raw, unbridled power, clubbing the delivery away to the boundary with absolute authority.
11.4: Axar Patel delivers, and Sherfane Rutherford sweeps it away behind square leg for a boundary.

11.5: Axar Patel offers a low full toss sliding down the leg-side, and Sherfane Rutherford unleashes a ferocious swing, scraping it off the back of the bat high over the wicketkeeper's head for a maximum.
11.6: Axar Patel spears this delivery in, and Sherfane Rutherford drives it away into the deep expanse of sweeper cover to scamper back for a comfortable couple of runs.
12.1: Naman Dhir drops a pinpoint yorker wide of the off stump, and Shai Hope does well to dig it out toward cover-point for a dot.
12.2: Naman Dhir floats one up to Shai Hope, who launches it cleanly over long-off for a maximum, boosting this growing partnership with Sherfane Rutherford.
12.3: Naman Dhir feeds one to Shai Hope, who nudges it into the depths of mid-wicket for a single.
12.4: Naman Dhir darts this wide delivery past Sherfane Rutherford, who leaves it alone expecting the umpire's arm to stretch, only to watch in fury as no wide is signaled.
12.5: Wide from Naman Dhir to Sherfane Rutherford.
12.5: Naman Dhir drops it up, Rutherford lofts it into the air where Abhishek gets fingertips to it but can only watch it sail over the rope for four.
12.6: Naman Dhir drifts into the arc, and Rutherford clears the fence with a clean, towering strike straight to long-off for six.
13.1: Arshdeep Singh fires a full delivery into off stump, and Shai Hope drives it smoothly down to long-on for a single.
13.2: Arshdeep Singh fires in a dipping low full toss outside off, and Sherfane Rutherford can only toe-end the heave out toward long-on for a single.
13.3: Arshdeep Singh delivers fuller outside off, and Shai Hope shuffling across simply steers it into the off-side gap to rotate the strike.

13.4: Arshdeep Singh fires in a pinpoint yorker that Sherfane Rutherford squeezes straight back into the turf, prompting a fleeting appeal from Shreyas before the umpire rightly dismisses the caught-behind suspicion.
13.5: Arshdeep Singh fires it in wide, but Sherfane Rutherford dances down the track, opens the blade, and slices it past backward point to fetch a vital boundary.
13.6: Arshdeep Singh fires in a pinpoint low full toss on the stumps, punched smoothly by Sherfane Rutherford down to long-on to squeeze out eight runs from the over.

14.2: Romario Shepherd does not score off Kuldeep Yadav.

14.4: Kuldeep Yadav loops one up, and Shai Hope sweeps it firmly away into the turf, racing past the fielder into the fence at deep square leg.

14.5: Kuldeep Yadav drops the googly short, Hope rocks back and fires it through the massive gap, while Arshdeep sprints across from deep cover to pull off a stunning save with full-stretch leather-chasing brilliance.
14.6: Kuldeep Yadav serves it up on middle and Romario Shepherd calmly works it down the ground for a single.
15.1: Axar Patel drifts this full delivery into the pads, and Romario Shepherd can only mistime his heavy slog out towards long-on for a single.
15.2: Axar Patel hurls it far too full, and Shai Hope survives an anxious inside edge crashing right back into his front pad.
15.3: Axar Patel errs with width and length outside off, offering Hope a release delivery that the batsman ruthlessly slaps away.
15.4: Axar Patel keeps it tidy, turning up to yield a single tucked neatly away toward short fine leg.
15.5: Axar Patel floats it up to Romario Shepherd, Sanju yells out the call, and Arshdeep launches himself into a sharp left-handed dive that denies any run.
15.6: Axar Patel serves it up again to Romario Shepherd, who launches a massive blow straight down the ground and over the long-on ropes for six.
16.1: Kuldeep Yadav searches for width outside off, but Shai Hope stays back and launches the delivery straight over the ropes for a maximum.
16.2: Kuldeep Yadav floats this one slower through the air, yet Shai Hope still dispatches it all the way over the ropes for a maximum.
16.3: Kuldeep Yadav serves it up on middle and leg, and Shai Hope drills the sweep flat and hard into the turf, racing away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
16.4: Kuldeep Yadav drops it full, and Romario Shepherd sinks to one knee, launching a flat, brutal maximum over mid-wicket for the third six of the over.
16.5: Kuldeep Yadav angles this one wide to Romario Shepherd, prompting an immediate wide signal from the umpire in a truly stunning moment.
16.5: Romario Shepherd does not score off Kuldeep Yadav.
16.6: Kuldeep Yadav drops it short and wide, and Romario Shepherd violently slaps the gift hard past cover-point for four, capping an astronomical twenty-four-run carnage from the over.
17.1: Arshdeep Singh fires in a dipping low full toss at the leg stump, deftly worked by Shai Hope out to long-on for a single.
17.2: Arshdeep Singh fires a pinpoint yorker angling down the leg-side, and Romario Shepherd deftly clips it behind square to rotate the strike.
17.3: Arshdeep Singh slips through with a low full toss, drilled hard down the ground before Tilak sprints across from long-on to restrict it to a single.
17.4: Arshdeep Singh offers a juicy full toss and Romario Shepherd launches it disdainfully over mid-wicket for a maximum.
17.5: Arshdeep Singh strays again and Romario Shepherd swiftly deflects it down to fine leg for four.
17.6: Arshdeep Singh fires it in, but Romario Shepherd slices it away behind point and watches it race to the fence for four.
18.1: Axar Patel floats it up to Shai Hope, who drops to one knee and launches a towering slog sweep sailing over long-on for six, storming to 96 with just four runs needed for victory.
18.2: Axar Patel fires in a flatter delivery on the stumps, and Shai Hope can only punch it straight to the cover fielder for a dot ball.
18.3: Axar Patel absorbs the final blow as Shai Hope launches him over the rope to seal the highest successful T20I chase for the West Indies with his second hundred in the format.
